summary: Macro markets are cautious ahead of major central-bank meetings: the dollar is firm, EUR/USD remains under pressure, and gold is rangebound to slightly softer. Equity sentiment is mixed, with renewed AI enthusiasm supporting technology and semiconductor shares, while oil has eased but Brent remains elevated because of geopolitical risk.[1][2][3]
